title: enums.yaml
description: Every controlled vocabulary with per-value glosses (10-design §8). Enum-valued TEXT columns are validated against this file at write time; there are no enum tables and no CHECK constraints mirroring these (§4.1).

enums.comment: Extra vocabularies beyond the required set are permitted (doc_type, phase, ...). The v3 required set's text_quality, evidence_tier, relation, independence, fetch_outcome, subject_kind, change_cause, review_verdict, review_stream and coverage_exhausted retired with v3: configs/enums.yaml (2026-10-14).

ordered.description: True for rank-ordered vocabularies; values are listed best-first.

nullable.description: True when the column is allowed to be NULL (absence is meaningful, e.g. sensitivity).
